text: Which lawyers in Melbourne are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?

result.keyword: Which lawyers in Melbourne are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?
result.markdown:
When looking for specialist lawyers in Melbourne to handle **Total and Permanent Disability (TPD)** and **superannuation insurance claims**, several well-regarded law firms specialize heavily in this area.[pksimpson.com.au](https://pksimpson.com.au/melbourne/) Most of these firms operate on a **"No Win, No Fee"** basis, meaning you generally do not pay legal costs unless your claim is successful.[aussieinjurylawyers.com.au](https://aussieinjurylawyers.com.au/legal-offices/superannuation-tpd-claims-melbourne/#:~:text=The%20good%20news%20is%20that%20our%20Victorian,Map%20Location.%20*%20Book%20Free%20Phone%20Appointment.)

Prominent and reputable firms handling TPD and superannuation claims in Melbourne include:

### 1. **Ryan Carlisle Thomas (RCT Law)**

* **Overview:** RCT Law is a long-established Victorian firm with decades of experience handling compensation, superannuation, and insurance disputes.
* **Specialty:** They regularly manage TPD claims, income protection claims, and early access to superannuation. They are well-known for handling union-affiliated and industry superannuation fund disputes.
* **Fee Structure:** Offers a "No Win, No Fee or Expenses" policy, meaning they also cover upfront disbursements/expenses if the claim is unsuccessful.[rctlaw.com.au](https://rctlaw.com.au/legal-services/superannuation-tpd-insurance/#:~:text=Superannuation%20TPD%20Insurance%20matters%20are%20included%20as,any%20expenses%20or%20disbursements%20that%20we%20incur.)

### 2. **LHD Lawyers (Melbourne Office)**

* **Overview:** LHD is a national compensation and insurance law firm with a dedicated team in Melbourne handling TPD and superannuation claims.
* **Specialty:** Navigating complex policy definitions, communicating with stubborn super funds and insurers, and managing rejected insurance claims.
* **Fee Structure:** No Win, No Fee.[www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/vic/melbourne/tpd-superannuation-claims/#:~:text=We're%20rated%204.8%20stars%20from%20100's%20of,explained%20everything%20clearly%20and%20simply.%20Highly%20recommended!)

### 3. **Aussie Injury Lawyers (Melbourne Office)**

* **Overview:** Operating out of Collins Street in Melbourne, they specifically focus on insurance law, TPD, and superannuation payout disputes.
* **Specialty:** Reviewing multiple historical policies, overturning rejected insurer decisions, and taking matters to the Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) if necessary.
* **Fee Structure:** No Win, No Fee.[aussieinjurylawyers.com.au](https://aussieinjurylawyers.com.au/legal-offices/superannuation-tpd-claims-melbourne/#:~:text=Whether%20you%20live%20in%20inner%20Melbourne%20or,supporting%20the%20people%20who%20depend%20on%20you.)

### 4. **PK Simpson (Melbourne)**

* **Overview:** PK Simpson has dedicated teams of specialist TPD and superannuation lawyers servicing Melbourne and greater Victoria.[pksimpson.com.au](https://pksimpson.com.au/melbourne/)
* **Specialty:** Assessing eligibility across multiple super funds, life insurance, and trauma insurance, as well as handling psychological injury TPD claims.
* **Fee Structure:** No Win, No Fee.

### 5. **Littles Lawyers**

* **Overview:** Littles is a national firm with a strong presence in Melbourne handling total and permanent disability and insurance litigation.[littleslawyers.com.au](https://littleslawyers.com.au/melbourne/tpd-insurance-lawyers/)
* **Specialty:** Assisting clients through the rigorous medical evidence requirements and administrative hurdles set by superannuation trustees.
* **Fee Structure:** No Win, No Fee models with initial free consultations.

---

### What to Look For & Tips When Choosing:

* **Check the Fee Agreement Carefully:** While "No Win, No Fee" is standard, ask whether "expenses" (such as medical reports, barrister fees, or court filing fees) are covered if you lose. Some firms require you to pay out-of-pocket expenses even if legal fees are waived.
* **Ask About Multi-Fund Policies:** A good TPD lawyer will investigate whether you have insurance policies attached to *multiple* superannuation funds (including old or forgotten accounts) to maximize your potential payout.
* **Initial Consultation:** Most of these firms offer a **free initial assessment** to review your policy terms and determine if you meet the definition of "Total and Permanent Disability" under your specific fund.[littleslawyers.com.au](https://littleslawyers.com.au/melbourne/tpd-insurance-lawyers/)
